channel.title: The Vicksburg Post - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Vicksburg Post (vicksburgpost.com)

item.title: Lady Vikes advance to 6A soccer semifinals for the third year in a row
item.description: Warren Central beat Center Hill 4-0 on Friday to advance to the MHSAA Class 6A girls soccer semifinals for the third consecutive season.

item.title: Baseball roundup: WC no-hits Madison but loses; Tallulah tops St. Al
item.description: BASEBALL ROUNDUP: Warren Central's pitching staff threw a no-hitter Friday but did not get a win against Madison Central, and Tallulah Academy spoiled St. Aloysius' home opener.

item.title: A Valentine's celebration of God's grace
item.description: Four local ministers reflect on Valentine's Day as a celebration of God’s grace, highlighting biblical love, Christ’s sacrifice, vulnerability and prayer.

item.title: Warren Central tennis aces Germantown
item.description: Warren Central's tennis team bounced back from two losses to start the season by beating Germantown 7-0 Friday at the Halls Ferry Park courts.

item.title: AROUND TOWN: Page for a week
item.description: Natalie Ford, daughter of Rep. Kevin Ford, served as a page this week in the Mississippi House of Representatives.

item.title: TEACHER OF THE YEAR: Burgos exposes students to different points of view
item.description: St. Aloysius English teacher Dorothy Burgos, an 11-year classroom veteran who blends literature with art and media, is a nominee for Educator of the Year.

item.title: Old Post Files: A look back over the last 100 years on Feb. 14, 2026
item.description: Old Post Files is a regular feature within the pages of The Vicksburg Post's print edition and digital e-edition. This feature looks back at some of the happenings from the pages of The Vicksburg Post over the past 100 years. Enjoy.

item.title: Hunters' Hall of Fame: Abel Hopkins
item.description: The Vicksburg Post invites its readers to submit their hunting photos. Please email them to sports@vicksburgpost.com or submit them online at vicksburgpost.com under the Hunters’ Hall of Fame tab.

item.title: Hawkins UMC to host drive-through Ash Wednesday
item.description: Hawkins UMC will host a drive-through Ash Wednesday observance Wednesday, 7–9 a.m., offering ashes, oil and optional prayer in the church's lower parking lot on Halls Ferry Road.

item.title: PHOTO GALLERY: Mardi Gras comes to Vicksburg
item.description: Check out our photo gallery of the Mardis Gras parade that took place in downtown Vicksburg on Saturday.
